author: Kairos II
title: Repoint canonical hybrid to z-score (w70/30) and update CANONICAL.txt
abstract: Copy z-score (w70/30) hybrid outputs onto canonical filenames and update the canonical note; preserve min-max variant.

original_submission.content:
import json, shutil
from pathlib import Path

over = Path('storage/shared/atlas/analysis/meta_edge_evolution/overlays')
z_png = over / 'evolution_liminal_overlay_hybrid_w70_30_zscore.png'
z_sum = over / 'evolution_liminal_overlay_hybrid_w70_30_zscore_summary.txt'
canon_png = over / 'evolution_liminal_overlay_hybrid_canonical.png'
canon_sum = over / 'evolution_liminal_overlay_hybrid_canonical_summary.txt'
note = over / 'CANONICAL.txt'

out = {}
if z_png.exists():
    shutil.copyfile(z_png, canon_png)
    out['canonical_panel'] = str(canon_png)
if z_sum.exists():
    shutil.copyfile(z_sum, canon_sum)
    out['canonical_summary'] = str(canon_sum)

with open(note, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
  f.write("Canonical hybrid: damped-dominant w=0.7 (damped), 0.3 (adjusted), norm=z-score\n")
  f.write(f"panel={canon_png}\n")
  f.write(f"summary={canon_sum}\n")
  f.write("Variants also available: w70_30_minmax, w30_70_minmax\n")
out['canonical_note'] = str(note)

print(json.dumps(out))
